listing_shares.notes: Input recovered from the previous stored valuation and its reference price.

revenue.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable.

free_cash_flow.notes: Operating cash flow TTM minus capex TTM. Capex is treated as a positive cash outflow.

debt.notes: Debt computed as sum of SEC debt components: CurrentLeaseLiabilities, NoncurrentLeaseLiabilities.

ebitda.notes: Input recovered from the previous stored valuation and its reference price.

forward_eps_public.notes: Yahoo expected EPS per listed share in USD; estimate methodology is not independently verified.

forward_eps_proxy.notes: Saved trailing EPS per listed share grown by 3-year EPS CAGR; not analyst consensus.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q2 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from SEC Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Debt computed as sum of SEC debt components: CurrentLeaseLiabilities, NoncurrentLeaseLiabilities.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

pe.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved net_income in the listing currency.

forward_pe_proxy.notes: Current price divided by the saved historical-growth EPS proxy.

forward_pe_public_estimate.notes: Current price divided by saved expected EPS from Yahoo or its implied forward P/E input; not an SEC fact.

peg_proxy.notes: Trailing P/E divided by saved 3-year EPS CAGR percentage.

eps_growth_3y_proxy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

ev_to_ebitda_proxy.notes: Current enterprise value divided by saved EBITDA in the listing currency.

enterprise_value_proxy.notes: Current market cap plus saved debt minus saved cash in the listing currency.

fcf_margin_ttm.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.
